questions.prompt:
A species of flowering plant is found in a desert environment where temperatures are high, precipitation is low/infrequent, and water rapidly evaporates from surfaces. 

Explain TWO structural OR physiological adaptations that would allow this plant to survive under these conditions.
questions.rubric_guide:
Max 6 pts. 6 pts for any answer containing 2 of any of the following examples: thick waxy cuticle, reduced leaf surface area/spines, deep or widespread root systems, succulent water-storage tissues, sunken stomata, or CAM photosynthesis.
3 pts if only one adaptation is listed.

questions.prompt:
A species of flowering plant is found in a desert environment where temperatures are high, precipitation is low/infrequent, and water rapidly evaporates from surfaces. 

During an extended period of drought, explain how the plant could reduce water loss while still obtaining the carbon dioxide necessary for photosynthesis.
questions.rubric_guide: Max 6 pts. 6pts for explanation including that plants close their stomata during the hottest/driest parts of the day and, in CAM plants, open them at night to take in CO₂ and store it for use during the day

questions.prompt:
Pollination can occur through biotic or abiotic agents.

Give one example of a biotic pollination agent and one example of an abiotic pollination agent.
questions.rubric_guide: Max 4 pts. 4 pts for having 1 biotic AND abiotic factors from the lists below: biotic; insects, birds, bats, and abiotic; wind or water. Give only 2 pts is only one is listed.

questions.prompt: Describe one floral characteristic that would be advantageous for a plant primarily pollinated by wind.
questions.rubric_guide: Max 4 pts. 4 pts for any answer including any of the following: Exposed/dangling anthers, lightweight pollen, large/feathery stigmas that capture airborne pollen.
